# Tab overflow shows a tab in its open menu and in the bar at once

## Context

`test/playwright/e2e/portal/NewsTabOverflow.spec.mjs` fails intermittently in hosted CI on heads whose diffs touch neither `src/tab/plugin/Overflow.mjs` nor the Portal news view. Four failures, each read from its job log on 2026-11-19:

| Run | Event · head | Test | Counted twice |
|---|---|---|---|
| 44077921709 | push `dev` · `a5e102c8f6` (11-17) | "every news tab stays reachable at 320×568" | `Blog` |
| 44089484144 | PR #21154 · `e949ea011e` (11-17) | "every news tab stays reachable at 390×664, and a tab chosen from the menu moves the route" | `Medium` |
| 44242798291 | push `dev` · `bdfc6a71ce` (11-18) | the 320×568 test | `Blog` |
| 44602416862, attempt 1 | PR #21510 · `7a7e6f4f46` (11-19) | the 390×664 test | `Medium` |

Each time `expect.poll(() => reachableTabs(page)).toEqual(TABS)` received eight labels instead of seven: the first hidden tab counted once as a header in the bar and once as an item of the open overflow menu, for the whole 5 s poll. A red `e2e-engine` shard costs an outside contributor a maintainer re-run.

**Reproduced locally (2026-11-19).** Random 0–250 ms delays were injected before the plugin's two `getLayoutRect()` round trips and before the lazy `menu/List.mjs` load (one shared delay per App worker). Under them the two phone cases failed 12 of 400 runs, each with the CI signature. Event logs from inside the plugin located the cause below.

## The Problem

Four fixes went into this surface: #20629 (the spec reads the bar while the menu is open), #20900 (the floating control mounts once), #21171 (the control retires with its toolbar) and #21303 (a pass without layout is skipped). Run 44602416862 came after all four. #20629 ruled out the test side: loosening the assertion (deduplicating, or accepting another count) is out of its scope, so the bar and the open menu have to describe one partition.

The open menu is not always the list the plugin updates.

## The Architectural Reality

Design authority: "An open menu and its rendered tab split are one addressable partition. A projection may neither clear the menu's record store nor change header visibility underneath it." (`src/tab/plugin/Overflow.mjs`, `project()`)

Read on `dev` at `4c3e2dc343`:

- The floating overflow control is a `button.Base` with a `menu` config. `afterSetMenu()` builds the `menu.List` in the callback of `import('../menu/List.mjs')` and assigns `me.menuList` there. Every `menu` change starts another build, and nothing destroys an earlier list.
- `Overflow#syncControl()` writes `control.menu` while the list does not exist yet, and the list's `items` once it does. Right after the plugin creates the control, the split often moves by one tab (the drained mount recapture), so a second build starts while the first is still loading.
- The two imports were observed to settle in either order, and `toggleMenu()` awaits the `menuListReady` it found at the click. The logged failures show both outcomes: the earlier menu's list lands last and becomes `menuList` with the older records (2 of 3), or the click opens the first list just before the second replaces `menuList` (1 of 3).
- Either way the bar shows the newer split, with the boundary tab visible, while the open list still holds the older split's records, which list that tab.

The ticket's first candidate (a measure window opening after the menu mounts) cannot occur on the Portal: it needs the bar's dock to change, and the news bar is created at `left` and stays there.

## The Fix

In `button.Base`: only the latest `menu` change builds a list (an import that settles after a newer change returns without building), a new list destroys the one it replaces, and `toggleMenu()` waits for the latest build. The plugin is unchanged.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: unit tests in `test/playwright/unit/button/Base.spec.mjs`, red on `dev`: a menu change while its list loads builds one list from the latest menu, and a click meanwhile opens it; a later menu replaces the list it built before.
- [ ] AC-2: `NewsTabOverflow.spec.mjs` keeps its assertions (seven labels, no deduplication).
- [ ] AC-3: the delay-injection probe above runs 400 times at the PR head without a duplicate (base: 12 of 400).
- [ ] ~~AC-4 (post-merge): no recurrence in `dev`'s engine e2e runs during the three days after merge, with the run count recorded.~~ Dropped: no open ticket would own it once the merge closes this one. AC-3's before/after on the same injection replaces it, and a later sighting re-opens the defect-note fold.

## Out of Scope

- Loosening the spec's assertion (#20629).
- The width cache taken while the web font loads (#20629's Out of Scope).
- `button.Effect` and `functional/button/Base` build their menu lists the same way; captured as a defect-note.
- The floating control observes its menu list late (only the action-mode control wires `onControlClick`), so `restoreOpenMenuPartition()` can miss a mount edge; latent on the Portal, captured as a defect-note.

## Avoided Traps

- A wait or retry in the spec: it narrows the window and hides a state a visitor can see, one tab listed twice.
- Making the plugin wait for `menuListReady` before writing `control.menu`: it would patch one consumer of a `button.Base` race that the Taskbar's start menu and `button.Split` reach too.
